mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) combined with a restrictive federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicates a recessionary labor market and tight monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion (HOUST > 2200) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 2200, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals an economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) combined with a restrictive federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months) signals a restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.
